newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh, Vietnam seek stronger ties.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh, Vietnam seek stronger ties.

text.p: Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina held talks on Monday with her Vietnamese counterpart Vo Van Kiet and officials hoped the meeting would strengthen economic and cultural cooperation.
Syed Abdus Samad, Hasina's principal secretary, said the talks focused on cooperation in agriculture because both countries have agrarian economies.
Bangladesh was impressed at the economic advancement of Vietnam since Hanoi began economic reforms in the 1980s, he told reporters after the talks.
Both sides stressed the need for more trade and stronger economic ties -- two areas which Dhaka officials consider "insignificant" at present.
The Vietnamese premier, the first Vietnamese head of government to visit Bangladesh, arrived in Dhaka on Sunday on a two-day visit.
The two countries on Monday signed four agreements, including establishing a joint economic commission.
Hasina said on Sunday a trade agreement signed in September may now be used to make "Bangladesh and Vietnam vigorously interact in this area".
